decisions.title: One user: the regulatory affairs analyst at a multi-state utility
The wedge is change-to-action, not search and not alerts
Citations are verified against source offsets, and an unverified claim cannot assert itself
Deterministic diff first, model interpretation second
Draft versus final is a first-class field, never inferred at read time
Confidence is explicit and low confidence escalates rather than guesses
Retrieval: lexical BM25 first, embeddings only where they earn it
The hosted instance at strata.sudama.ai is the primary surface; the local run remains the contract
Strata gets its own disposable droplet, not the existing shared one
Caddy and Docker Compose, not Coolify
ADR-007 reaffirmed: server-rendered templates with a hand-built design system
Four screens, and the citation chip is where the hard bet becomes visible
Secrets live in one gitignored file, copied at the narrowest possible width

known_gaps: The verifier confirms a quoted passage EXISTS at the cited offsets. It does not confirm the passage supports the claim attached to it. Named in docs/security.html.
The audit hash chain detects tampering; it does not prevent it. Closing that needs the chain head published outside the host.
_spans_of in app/verification/verifier.py falls back to fixed-width window scanning, which breaks once normalization changes length -- i.e. on real PDF text.
The eval corpus has five labelled changes. No percentage computed over five items should be reported as a measurement.
